fact: The CNIAPGE director general said that since 2015 it has built an internationally rated state data centre and informatised 14 institutions (Presidency, Interior, Finance, Public Service, Justice and others), connected to the government's gob.gq services over a private government network.
title: CNIAPGE: 7 años de existencia, un compromiso: informatizar a toda la administración pública de Guinea Ecuatorial
